Name: Sprint Sprint
Author: JessebotX
Description:
This mod is a rewrite/better version/sequel of Sprint Sprint Sprint (the discontinued mod)

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
[list][*] Allows the player to sprint (Hold to Sprint/Toggle to Sprint option)
[*] Stamina drain option for when you are sprinting
[*] Prevent player from sprinting when stamina is low
[*] All features [url=https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/Sprint%20Sprint/docs/configuration.md]highly configurable[/url]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Usage[/size][/b]
When in game (when your farmer can move), use the configured button (default Left Shift) to sprint

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[u]Dependencies[/u]
[list][*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b](REQUIRED)[/b] - The Stardew Valley mod loader
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [b](OPTIONALl)[/b] - Allows configuring the options of this mod in game
[/list]
[u]Installation[/u]
[list][*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*][b](OPTIONALl)[/b] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*]Install this mod and extract/unzip into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[/list]need help/don't understand? check out the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Player's Guide to Installing and Using Mods[/url] and the Stardew Valley Discord

[u]Uninstallation[/u]
[list][*] Delete the folder Sprint Sprint from your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[/list][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list][*][color=#ffff00]Windows ✓[/color]
[*][color=#ffff00]Mac ✓[/color]
[*][color=#ffff00]Linux ✓[/color]
[*][color=#ffffff]Android [b]?[/b] - needs verification[/color]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Migrating from Sprint Sprint Sprint (old version)[/size][/b][/list]
See [url=https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/Sprint%20Sprint/docs/migration.md]migration guide[/url] for more details
Simply uninstall Sprint Sprint Sprint and download this mod

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
See [url=https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewValleyMods/blob/master/Sprint%20Sprint/docs/configuration.md]configuration documentation[/url] for all options
There are 2 ways to edit the config file
[list][*]Download optional dependency Generic Mod Config Menu and you can configure the mod to your liking while in the title screen on a much friendlier user interface (A button is added to the title screen in the bottom left to access the config menus.)
[*]Run the game with this mod installed once to generate a config.json in your Stardew Valley/Mods/Sprint Sprint/ folder and directly edit the config.json file with a text editor (i.e. Notepad, Notepad++, Sublime Text, etc.)
[/list]If you choose the second option, you NEED to run the game once in order for a config.json to appear.If the config.json gets replaced/deleted, the game will generate a new config.json with default settings
